findings.issue: The review workflow's stop-order list claims to give the whole decision ("the script applies this fixed order, first match wins") but stops at the floor and jumps to the legal-stop gates. convergence.cjs applies the frontierOpen veto to every review candidate after minIterations and before the gates (lines 1192-1196), and because a review clean candidate is a hard stop that veto is the one that matters most. The file's own divergent frontier_gate at line 1373 states the veto already returns CONTINUE while a node is open, so a reader of the ordered list believes an open frontier cannot hold a clean review stop when it does.

evidence.cmd: rg -n "frontierOpen|4a\. if iteration_count|5\. the nine legal-stop gates" .skilled/commands/deep/assets/deep-review.yaml .skilled/skills/system-deep-loop/runtime/scripts/convergence.cjs
